name: Hearthlift Courier V3 · Difficulty 3 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Load the ember crate and wake the lifts. Carry it across the moving lift stacks. Click the courier in the overhead chart, then click an intended landing spot to hop. BURN CRATE releases the crate. CANCEL AIM cancels aiming. The aim sets speed for a nominal 1.6s hop; elevation and inherited lift motion change the landing. Click a moving lift top in the overhead chart to inspect its concealed motor survey. Its next 3.2s of motion then appears in both views and stays live once inspected. Inspect safely from the quay before hopping; inspection does not launch the courier or pause the lifts. Land inside a top, burn at the hearth, and certify. Falling or releasing away from the hearth ends the episode. A rejected CERTIFY DELIVERY also ends the episode. Aim previews, canceled aims and rejected out-of-range aims remain recoverable. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
